description: End-to-end analytics and reporting workflow for TAAS Camara device swap operations, from data ingestion and aggregation to KPI computation, anomaly detection, and report generation.

swap_session_id.description: Unique identifier for a device swap session or transaction group.

tenant_id.description: Identifier for the tenant (e.g., operator, enterprise customer) in the TAAS Camara ecosystem.

device_id.description: Unique identifier of a device involved in a swap (IMEI, eSIM ID, or internal ID).

analytics_job_id.description: Identifier for an analytics processing job or pipeline execution.

report_id.description: Identifier for a generated analytics report.

dashboard_id.description: Identifier for a saved analytics dashboard configuration.

audit_event_id.description: Identifier of an audit log entry.

subscription_id.description: Identifier of a webhook or notification subscription.

snapshot_id.description: Identifier of a captured state snapshot.

functions.name: ingest_device_swap_events
functions.description: Ingest raw device swap events for analytics processing, including metadata and normalization hints.

tenant_id.description: Tenant for which events are being ingested.

ingestion_mode.description: Whether events are streamed or batch-loaded.

swap_session_id.description: Associated swap session if known; can be empty for pre-session events.

previous_device_id.description: Previous device being swapped from, if applicable.

attributes.description: Arbitrary key-value attributes for analytic enrichment.

normalization_hints.description: Optional hints for schema mapping and normalization.

time_zone.description: Time zone for timestamps if not in UTC (e.g., 'Europe/Berlin').

id_mapping.description: Mapping keys used by the source for IDs.

dry_run.description: If true, validate only without persisting.

functions.returns: Ingestion summary including number of accepted events, rejected events, validation errors, and a reference analytics_job_id if persisted.

functions.name: configure_analytics_metric
functions.description: Create or update a custom analytics metric definition for device swap analysis.

definition.description: Metric definition containing formula and dimensions.

formula.description: Declarative formula for computing the metric.

numerator.description: Expression or event filter for numerator.

denominator.description: Expression or event filter for denominator; may be omitted for simple counts.

dimensions.description: List of dimensions by which the metric can be sliced.

key.description: Field path or logical dimension name.

windowing.description: Default time windowing configuration for the metric.

functions.returns: Metric configuration confirmation including current definition, version, and status.

functions.name: run_device_swap_analytics_job
functions.description: Trigger an analytics job to compute metrics and aggregates for device swap sessions over a specified period.

time_zone.description: Time zone for bucketing; defaults to tenant's time zone.

metrics.description: List of metric keys to compute; if omitted, uses tenant defaults.

filters.description: Filter criteria for which swap sessions to include.

output.description: Output settings for the analytics job.

path.description: Target path for exports when using external storage.

functions.returns: Analytics job metadata including analytics_job_id, status, estimated completion time, and summary of requested metrics and aggregations.

functions.name: get_analytics_job_status
functions.description: Get status, progress, and partial results metadata for an analytics job.

include.description: Additional information to include in the response.

functions.returns: Analytics job status including current state, progress percentage, any errors or warnings, and links to final or intermediate result sets.

functions.name: list_swap_sessions_for_analytics
functions.description: List device swap sessions and their high-level metrics for exploratory analytics and drill-down.

items.description: List of device_id values to filter.

functions.returns: Paginated list of swap sessions with basic fields (swap_session_id, status, duration, channel, device summary) and lightweight derived metrics.

functions.name: get_swap_session_insights
functions.description: Retrieve detailed analytics and event timeline for a specific device swap session.
functions.returns: Structured analytics view for the given swap_session_id including ordered events, stage durations, failure root causes, and recommendation hints if any.

functions.name: compute_swap_kpis
functions.description: Compute high-level KPIs for device swap performance, such as success rate, average duration, and rollback frequency.

kpis.description: List of KPI identifiers to compute; if empty, compute standard KPI set.

use_cached_results.description: If true, prefer existing analytics_job outputs when available.

functions.returns: KPI results with overall values, segmented breakdowns, and metadata about data freshness and sample size.

functions.name: detect_swap_anomalies
functions.description: Run anomaly detection on device swap metrics to identify spikes, drops, and unusual patterns.

scope.description: Scope of metrics and segments to analyze for anomalies.

detection_config.description: Configuration of the anomaly detection algorithm.

baseline_window.description: Historical window used as baseline, e.g., '30d'.

min_support.description: Minimum number of swap sessions required to consider a segment.

functions.returns: List of detected anomalies with scores, affected segments, time intervals, suspected root causes, and severity levels.

functions.name: generate_device_swap_report
functions.description: Generate a comprehensive analytics report for device swap performance over a period, suitable for business stakeholders.

sections.description: Specific sections to include for custom template; ignored for non-custom templates.

source_analytics_job_id.description: Optional existing analytics_job_id to base the report on, avoiding recomputation.

functions.returns: Report metadata including report_id, generation status, storage location, delivery outcome, and key KPI highlights.

functions.name: retry_analytics_job
functions.description: Retry a failed or partially failed analytics job with optional overrides for configuration.

retry_mode.description: Whether to continue from last checkpoint or restart from scratch.

override.description: Optional configuration overrides applied during retry.

max_parallelism.description: Maximum parallel workers allowed for this job.

skip_steps.description: Pipeline steps to skip on retry.

reason.description: Human-readable reason for retrying, used for audit trails.

functions.returns: New or updated analytics_job_id, retry status, and information about which steps will be re-executed.

functions.name: rollback_analytics_aggregation
functions.description: Rollback previously materialized analytics aggregates or KPIs for device swap data when they are found to be incorrect.

analytics_job_id.description: Roll back artifacts produced by this job.

metric_keys.description: Alternatively, roll back selected metrics across one or more jobs.

time_range.description: Time window to apply rollback for metric-based rollbacks.

dry_run.description: If true, report what would be rolled back without performing changes.

functions.returns: Rollback summary including affected aggregates, metrics, and a rollback operation identifier for auditing.

functions.name: create_or_update_analytics_dashboard
functions.description: Create or update a saved analytics dashboard configuration for device swap monitoring.

dashboard_id.description: Existing dashboard_id to update; omit for create.

query.description: Metric and filter configuration powering the widget.

functions.returns: Dashboard configuration including dashboard_id, version, and shareable access URL or token.

functions.name: get_report_or_dashboard_view
functions.description: Retrieve a rendered view or metadata for a generated report or saved dashboard for device swap analytics.

view_options.description: Options for how to materialize the view.

functions.returns: Rendered view payload or metadata for the specified report_id or dashboard_id, including URLs, embedded HTML (if requested), and effective filters.

functions.name: search_swap_sessions
functions.description: Faceted search across swap_session records with rich filters, full-text query, and faceted aggregations for device_swap_analytics_flow.

filters.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

highlight.description: Return highlighted snippets when matching text

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A paginated result set of swap_session records with facet buckets, total count, and continuation cursor.

functions.name: list_swap_sessions_by_status
functions.description: List swap_session records filtered by lifecycle status with stable cursor pagination.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A paginated list of swap_session records matching the requested statuses, optionally with summary metrics.

functions.name: get_swap_session_detail
functions.description: Fetch a single swap_session record with optional expansion of related entities and versioned snapshots.

as_of.description: Read the record as of this point in time

version_id.description: Specific version to retrieve when versioning is enabled

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A swap_session record with the requested expansions and version metadata.

functions.name: bulk_create_swap_sessions
functions.description: Submit a batch of swap_session records for creation, with idempotency keys and partial-success reporting.

tags.description: Tags applied to the new record

trace_id.description: Correlation id propagated across the batch

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A per-item outcome list with created identifiers, validation errors, and batch-level statistics.

functions.name: bulk_update_swap_sessions
functions.description: Apply partial updates to many swap_session records in a single transactional batch.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

patch.description: JSON merge-patch applied to every matched record

dry_run.description: Compute affected count without applying changes

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Affected record count, sampled previews, and any per-record errors.

functions.name: bulk_archive_swap_sessions
functions.description: Soft-archive swap_session records matching a selector with optional grace period before purge.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

preserve_audit.description: Keep audit trail even after purge

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Archive operation summary including matched count, scheduled purge date, and any blockers.

functions.name: export_swap_sessions
functions.description: Asynchronously export a filtered slice of swap_session records to the configured object store.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

destination.description: Where the export should be delivered

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: An export job descriptor with status, destination URI, and progress callbacks.

functions.name: subscribe_swap_session_events
functions.description: Register a webhook subscription for swap_session lifecycle events with HMAC signing and replay protection.

filter.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

signing_secret_ref.description: Reference to the HMAC signing secret

tls_verify.description: Whether to validate the server certificate

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A subscription handle including subscription_id, verification status, and current delivery health.

functions.name: unsubscribe_swap_session_events
functions.description: Disable or delete a previously created swap_session event subscription.

drain_seconds.description: Grace period to flush in-flight events

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Final subscription state and any undelivered event counts at the time of termination.

functions.name: get_swap_session_audit_history
functions.description: Retrieve the chronological audit log for a swap_session including who changed what and when.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: An ordered list of audit entries with diffs, actor metadata, and correlation ids.

functions.name: query_swap_session_changelog
functions.description: Query the cross-record changelog for device_swap_analytics_flow with field-level filters.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

fields_changed.description: Restrict to changes touching these fields

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Aggregated changelog rows or detail entries depending on group_by, plus totals.

functions.name: schedule_swap_session_job
functions.description: Create a recurring or one-off scheduled job that runs a device_swap_analytics_flow operation.

operation.description: Operation name to invoke when the schedule fires

input_template.description: Parameters passed to the operation, with templating

failure_policy.description: What to do when a run fails

max_failures.description: Pause schedule after this many failures

alert_channel.description: Channel id to alert on failure

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A schedule descriptor including schedule_id, next run time, and validation issues.

functions.name: pause_swap_session_schedule
functions.description: Temporarily pause a scheduled device_swap_analytics_flow job without deleting its history.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Updated schedule status and prior pause history.

functions.name: simulate_swap_session_execution
functions.description: Run a dry-run simulation of a device_swap_analytics_flow execution path without producing side effects.

include_side_effect_plan.description: Return the side effects that would have been emitted

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Simulation transcript with predicted outcome, side-effect plan, and assertions checked.

functions.name: preview_swap_session_change
functions.description: Compute a preview of how a proposed change would affect a swap_session prior to commit.

evaluate_policies.description: Run policy engine against the proposed state

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A preview document with field diffs, policy verdicts, and dependency impact.

functions.name: submit_swap_session_for_approval
functions.description: Submit a swap_session for review with configurable approver routing and SLA targets.

approver_group.description: Group or role authorised at this step

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Approval workflow handle with approval_id, current step, and projected completion time.

functions.name: record_swap_session_approval_decision
functions.description: Record an approve/reject/recuse decision for a pending swap_session approval step.

conditions.description: Conditions attached to a conditional approval

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Updated approval state, next pending step, and any triggered automations.

functions.name: escalate_swap_session
functions.description: Escalate a stuck or breached swap_session to a higher tier with paging and audit.

target_team.description: Team or rota receiving the escalation

context_refs.description: Related artifact ids attached for context

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Escalation record id, paged responders, and acknowledgement timer.

functions.name: add_swap_session_comment
functions.description: Append a comment, optionally with @mentions and visibility scope, to a swap_session.

mentions.description: User ids mentioned in the body

parent_comment_id.description: Comment id this one replies to

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Newly created comment record including comment_id and resolved mentions.

functions.name: attach_swap_session_evidence
functions.description: Upload an evidence file or link as an attachment to a swap_session with content hash and retention.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Attachment descriptor including attachment_id, content hash, and stored URI.

functions.name: snapshot_swap_session_state
functions.description: Capture a point-in-time snapshot of a swap_session and its dependencies for restore or audit.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor with snapshot_id, captured size, and storage URI.

functions.name: restore_swap_session_from_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a swap_session (and optionally dependencies) from a previously captured snapshot.

new_owner_id.description: Owner of the restored record when mode=new_record

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Restore job descriptor with conflicts surfaced and final record id.

functions.name: get_swap_session_metrics_summary
functions.description: Compute summary KPIs for device_swap_analytics_flow over a time window with optional segmentation.

metrics.description: Metric names to compute (e.g. throughput, p95_latency, failure_rate)

filters.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

compare_to_previous_period.description: Include delta vs the previous equal-length window

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A metrics document with per-bucket values, totals, and optional period-over-period deltas.

functions.name: create_swap_session_dashboard
functions.description: Define a dashboard layout combining charts and tables for device_swap_analytics_flow.

query.description: Query spec, polymorphic by panel type

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Dashboard descriptor including dashboard_id and resolved share list.

functions.name: define_swap_session_policy
functions.description: Create or version a policy controlling allowed device_swap_analytics_flow behaviour.

rules.description: Ordered rule list, first match wins

when.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

enforcement_mode.description: How strictly the policy is applied

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Policy version descriptor with policy_id, version_id, and validation report.

functions.name: evaluate_swap_session_policies
functions.description: Evaluate the active device_swap_analytics_flow policies against a candidate input and return verdicts.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Aggregate verdict, per-rule outcomes, and any obligations attached to the decision.

functions.name: link_swap_session_dependencies
functions.description: Declare typed dependency links between a swap_session and related artifacts to drive impact analysis.

replace_existing.description: Replace prior links of the same relations

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Resulting link set with created, updated, and removed entries.
